title: Create and run a oneshot systemd unit
prompt:
The board is already reachable over SSH (MOSS_DEVICE_*).

Create /etc/systemd/system/moss-bench-marker.service, a Type=oneshot unit whose ExecStart writes the single line {{TOKEN}} to {{ROOT}}/systemd-proof.txt. daemon-reload and start that unit only. Record evidence metric `unit_result` whose observed value is the trimmed output of `systemctl show -p Result --value moss-bench-marker` (it must be success).

Do not enable a reboot, do not restart ssh, and do not edit firewall or network configuration. The bench removes this unit afterwards.
oracle:
cat > /etc/systemd/system/moss-bench-marker.service <<EOF
[Unit]
Description=Moss bench marker oneshot
[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p "$MOSS_BENCH_ROOT" && printf "%s\n" "$MOSS_BENCH_TOKEN" > "$MOSS_BENCH_ROOT/systemd-proof.txt"'
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
